W68X: The person who follows his own mind goes astray (from the right road of life) and comes into the dependence of Yama,

having gone astray he is being robbed (in the same way) as the person who recites mantras in the cremation ground (has taken to an evil path).

ZUQY: Lavai = he keeps crying out. Kuban = evil words.

XS5V: O Nanak! Know that comfort has come to the one who is dyed in the true Lord. ||26||

ETBQ: The person who walks in accordance with the Satguru settles the fear of the true Lord within his heart,

4665: Agharr = the unyielding mind, that which is not well shaped.
through the Guru's bani he shapes his unyielding mind into a fine one,

The Guru-ward makes sweet his unrefined speech.

2DJ5: he sings the praise of the spotless Lord,
The Gurmukh sings the immaculate, Glorious Praises of the Lord.

RY1V: Param pad = the highest state of all.
(and in this way) he attains a pure and high spiritual state.
The Gurmukh attains the supreme, sanctified status.
The Guru-ward, attains the pure supreme status.

DAS6: Rom rom = through each and every hair; (that is,) with body and mind.

KEN6: O Nanak! (Through devotion) the Gurmukh remains absorbed in the ever-abiding Lord. ||27||
O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in Truth. ||27||
Nanak, the God-conscious being merges in the True Lord.

L9DT: By making a deep acquaintance with the Guru one crosses the world-ocean,

N09J: Giani = one of knowledge, one who has deep acquaintance with the Lord.
through the Guru's shabad one becomes one who has acquaintance with the Lord,

and through the Guru's shabad the understanding of the inner self comes.

YU3Z: Alakh = the one who has no particular mark, sign or feature.

By Guru's grace one attains to the Invisible and infinite Lord.

P655: O Nanak! It is through the Guru alone that the road to release (from egotism) is found. ||28||

0ZTJ: Akath = that which cannot be told, whose true form cannot be described. Bichar = through reflection.

Through the Guru the reflection upon (akath) Waheguru is uttered.
KZKE: Nibahai = he comes through. Sparvar = sa-parvar, while living among the family.

37Y1: Antar = within the heart. Piar = with love.

The holyman contemplates his Lord with hearty love.

KL8F: Sabad = through the Guru's shabad. Achar = through conduct, with good character.

Q6ZE: O Nanak! The Gurmukh, having burnt (his own) egotism (self-interest), remains absorbed (in the Lord). ||29||

GT8Z: Without the true shabad no person can obtain honour.

SQ00: Ur dhar = ur-dhar, having borne within the heart. Ur = the heart ||34||

Through the Nameable Lord's Name, he remains dispassionate and keeps the True Name enshrined in his mind.

without meeting the True Guru, no one is liberated.
